name: Mind map
oneLiner: a glass hub with a lit accent orb lands, 3 to 6 curved wires grow out of it one after another with a spark on each tip, glass glyph nodes pop where they land; then the hub fires and light runs out along every wire at once, flashing each node
say: when the speaker turns one thing into many ('one video becomes clips, a newsletter, a blog post...'): cut in on the one thing, a branch grows per item named, the hub fires on the payoff line. Set hero to keep one branch lit
